_comment: The background overlays that ship with Golf Tycoon, painted over whichever picture is showing - so the two settings combine. `pattern` names one of MenuBackdropOverlay's painters: none, wash, vignette, glow, split, stripes, grid, scanlines, dots, sparkle. `color` is the ink, `strength` its opacity (0-1), `scale` the pattern's feature size in logical pixels. `setting_ids` lists the extra choices the overlay exposes; each one is declared in the `settings` block below (a mod may declare its own alongside these). `seasons` and `themes` are what Auto looks at, exactly like a picture's. A mod adds overlays with content.menu_overlays in its mod.json.

none.name: None
none.description: The plain picture, with only the shading that keeps the headings readable.

vignette.name: Vignette
vignette.description: A soft darkening toward the corners that draws the eye to the cards in the middle.

evening_wash.name: Evening Wash
evening_wash.description: A warm gold wash over the whole picture, like a lamp-lit clubhouse at dusk.

sand_haze.name: Sand Haze
sand_haze.description: A pale bunker-sand haze that pushes the picture back behind the cards.

fairway_stripes.name: Fairway Stripes
fairway_stripes.description: Mown fairway bands laid over the picture - the clubhouse's own lawn.

lattice.name: Clubhouse Lattice
lattice.description: A fine square lattice, like the leaded windows over the clubhouse doors.

scanlines.name: CRT Scanlines
scanlines.description: Thin horizontal lines across the whole screen, like an old console display.

pixel_halftone.name: Pixel Halftone
pixel_halftone.description: A coarse dot screen that tiles the picture into pixels, like printed poster art.

dew_sparkle.name: Dew Sparkle
dew_sparkle.description: Scattered glints of morning dew catching the light across the grass.

flag_glow.name: Flag Glow
flag_glow.description: A warm glow rising from the bottom of the screen, under the buttons.

split_light.name: Split Light
split_light.description: Half the picture in shade, half in sun - light falling across the clubhouse.

angle.name: Angle
angle.description: Which way the pattern runs, in degrees.

density.name: Density
density.description: How many glints are scattered across the picture.
